en.name: Excalidraw Studio
en.description: Draw technical architecture, domain-model, flowchart and sequence diagrams on an Excalidraw canvas inside the work panel. Four starters generate a first draft you can drag around; scenes save as .excalidraw files in diagrams/ and export to SVG. Pairs with the Archify plugin: import an Archify architecture candidate JSON onto the canvas to hand-edit it, and open Archify's generated HTML straight from the toolbar. Ships self-update commands backed by this repo's latest.json.
en.safetyNotes: Reads and writes only inside the workspace: reads diagrams/** and *.excalidraw, writes diagrams/**. Drawing is local (fonts and the Excalidraw bundle ship with the plugin). Self-update downloads only the URL listed for this plugin in this repo's latest.json (host-gated to the declared net.domains), verifies sha256 and size, unpacks a store-only .piplug, backs up the current files to the OS temp dir and then replaces them; node_modules is never touched.
